controller: i.MX95 Cortex-M7 PX4 HITL, system ID 1
companion: i.MX95 Linux, NPU YOLOv8s, ROS 2 DDS guidance

recording.hud_layout: Compact hardware badge, status pill and grouped bottom data dock

notes: Only traffic fixtures are scripted; PX4 controls the aircraft.
Target range and speed in the HUD are vision-derived estimates.
Drone actual/command are horizontal speed magnitudes, altitude is relative to takeoff, yaw error is command minus measured heading.
Input age is evaluated by guidance; it is not inference time alone.
Normal board services and saved M7 parameters restored after flight.
No lane changes, overtaking, occlusion recovery or obstacle avoidance validated in this run.
